primary_witness.archive: SNLTR Rabindra Rachanabali digital edition (digitization of Swarabitan, Visva-Bharati)

provenance.encoding_method: automated parse of the witness's notation grid (tools/parse_nltr.py) + manual review of every line

notes: Archive-derived (v0.2): encoded from the online witness; not yet checked against a printed Swarabitan page.

Taal conflict, recorded rather than resolved: the witness names the taal দাদরা (normally six matras), but this page prints a five-matra avartan divided 2+3 — bars every five cells, and আবর্তন ৩ across a fifteen-cell line, which is internally consistent. We encode the cycle the page notates. A check against the printed Swarabitan would settle it.
